# feature-intake Specification

## Purpose

Turn a raw feature request into a confirmed, well-formed intake issue that
downstream planning can act on.

## Requirements

### Requirement: New feature intake
<!-- slug: new-feature-intake -->

The system SHALL draft a candidate intake issue from a raw feature
request and MUST require explicit human confirmation before the issue is
recorded.

#### Scenario: Human confirms the drafted issue
<!-- slug: human-confirms-the-drafted-issue -->

- **GIVEN** a raw feature request has been submitted
- **GIVEN** the system has drafted a candidate intake issue
- **WHEN** the human confirms the drafted issue
- **THEN** the intake issue is recorded
- **THEN** the raw request is linked to the recorded issue

#### Scenario: Human rejects the drafted issue
<!-- slug: human-rejects-the-drafted-issue -->

- **GIVEN** the system has drafted a candidate intake issue
- **WHEN** the human rejects the drafted issue
- **THEN** no intake issue is recorded

### Requirement: Oversized request is flagged
<!-- slug: oversized-request-is-flagged -->

The system SHALL flag a feature request whose scope exceeds the
configured capability-size threshold.

#### Scenario: Request exceeds the threshold
<!-- slug: request-exceeds-the-threshold -->

- **GIVEN** the capability-size threshold is configured
- **WHEN** a request exceeding the threshold is submitted
- **THEN** the request is flagged as oversized
